text:
Nora Kim: quick note from today's onboarding 12: several new hires hit a crash when following the 'tooling + json_mode' lab. stack trace points to parser state after auth refresh.
Jay Park: did they use custom retry logic? our SDK has built-in retry but the bootcamp uses a minimal fetch wrapper.
Nora Kim: yes, they added an axios interceptor that refreshes token then replays the same streaming request. when json_mode is true the second stream frames are concatenated and the parser errors with 'Extra data after top-level value'.
Ellen Zhou: ugh. that lines up with a parser buffer not being reset before reattaching. two quick mitigations: server-side idempotency to dedupe retries, and SDK-side parser reset on retry.
Jay Park: agree. short-term: patch the sample app to show an idempotency_key example. longer-term: offer a convenience helper in the SDK so beginners don't have to implement safe retries.
Ellen Zhou: sample snippet we can add to bootcamp README:
```js
// bootcamp: use idempotency to avoid duplicate streaming frames on retry
const res = await client.responses.create({
  model: 'redwood-chat-1',
  json_mode: true,
  idempotency_key: `bootcamp-${userId}-${Date.now()}`,
  function_call: { name: 'book_appointment', arguments_schema: apptSchema },
  input: prompt
});
```
Jay Park: also think the SDK should expose createSafe or createWithRetrySafe that: adds idempotency_key when absent, and resets internal streaming parser if a retry path is taken (auth or network). reduces onboarding friction.
Nora Kim: that would be great. people in the room were confused because the error looked like a crash, not a retry artifact.
Ellen Zhou: small doc blurb: "If you implement client-side retries for streaming json_mode, either (a) use idempotency_key so the server dedupes/patches streams, or (b) ensure you tear down/reset any streaming JSON parser before retrying."
Jay Park: will file the SDK issue and add a regression test that simulates a 401 mid-stream to verify parser reset.
Nora Kim: I'll update the onboarding slides + bootcamp README to include the idempotency example and a troubleshooting FAQ entry.
Devex Bot: New issue created: DEVEX-1433 12: "createWithRetrySafe helper + reset JSON parser on auth-retry" https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/DEVEX-1433 :white_check_mark:
Jay Park: picking DEVEX-1433. ETA: patch + tests by EOW.
Ellen Zhou: after SDK patch i'll open the bootcamp PR to swap the naive example for the idempotency pattern.
Nora Kim: huge thanks 44d this will avoid more onboarding confusion.
